card.text: Explore 1950 DA in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: 1950 DA is a near-Earth asteroid with a rounded, oblate radar shape and an equatorial ridge. Explore its original shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. This view uses the published 2007 retrograde reconstruction. The 2014 Yarkovsky analysis rules out the prograde alternative. About 30% of the retrograde model surface was unseen or seen at incidence angles above 75 degrees in the original observations, so that region depends on the model assumptions. No optical surface map is supplied.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
